### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Usher syndrome type 3A  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12605)

**Proposed mechanism:** CLRN1 (HGNC:2375) —DISRUPTS→ Endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030431); Endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030431) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000547); Endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) (GO:0030431) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0001250). Loss-of-function mutations in CLRN1 disrupt ER-associated degradation (ERAD) pathway, leading to the accumulation of misfolded proteins and cellular stress. This disruption ultimately results in retinal degeneration and hearing impairment, the shared phenotypic features of MONDO:0013610 and Usher syndrome type 3A.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in CLRN1 with a minor allele frequency greater than 1% in gnomAD would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: CLRN1)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving CLRN1 and the ERAD pathway could lead to the development of therapeutic strategies targeting protein degradation or cellular stress response that benefit patients with both MONDO:0013610 and Usher syndrome type 3A.
